sub_sector.value: regulated water and wastewater utility; water contract operations

industry_position.detail: Regulated water and wastewater utility in New Jersey and Delaware; contract operation of municipal and private systems.

commodity_exposure.detail: Collects, treats, distributes and sells water; also wastewater services.

revenue_structure.detail: Rates regulated by state utility commissions; smaller non-regulated contract operations revenue.

energy_transition.detail: Water utility with no fossil or renewable energy production.
